description: This file implements an interval tree data structure with red-black tree properties, supporting interval overlap, insertion, deletion, and various interval comparisons. It includes classes and methods for managing interval nodes, tree balancing, and interval operations, with specialized comparables for different data types.

classes.name: intervalNode
classes.description: Node of the interval red-black tree, containing interval data, color, and tree links.

classes.name: IntervalValue
classes.description: Holds an interval and its associated value.

classes.name: intervalTree
classes.description: Implements a red-black tree-based interval tree with methods for insertion, deletion, and querying.

classes.name: StringComparable
classes.description: String type implementing Comparable interface for lexicographical comparison.

classes.name: StringAffineComparable
classes.description: String type treating empty string as greater than all others for comparison.

classes.name: Int64Comparable
classes.description: Int64 type implementing Comparable for numeric comparison.

classes.name: BytesAffineComparable
classes.description: Byte slice type treating empty byte slices as greater for comparison.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Implements comparison logic for various comparable types.

methods.name: NewStringInterval
methods.description: Creates an Interval from string bounds.

methods.name: NewStringPoint
methods.description: Creates a point interval from a string.

methods.name: NewStringAffinePoint
methods.description: Creates a point affine string interval.

methods.name: NewInt64Interval
methods.description: Creates an interval from two int64 values.

methods.name: NewInt64Point
methods.description: Creates a point interval from an int64 value.

methods.name: NewBytesAffineInterval
methods.description: Creates an affine byte slice interval.

methods.name: NewBytesAffinePoint
methods.description: Creates a point affine byte slice interval.
